lastCompletedStory.title: Plan-runner terminal for invalid explicit target + explicit-target-wins regression test

openQuestions: During one bun run check:all pass (before the final green one recorded in worker-report.json), test/ui/init-setup-screen-keys.test.ts's 'renders check glyph and All set/Next sections' test failed transiently under system CPU load (a fixed 600ms setTimeout in the test was not enough time for the async prereq-check simulation to settle). Running it in isolation (3x) and re-running the full bun test / bun run check:all suite both came back 100% green with 0 fail. This test lives entirely outside plan-runner.ts / select.ts (this story's surface) so it was not touched or fixed here; flagging in case it resurfaces for a future story working in src/ui/InitScreen or its test file -- consider swapping the fixed setTimeout for a bounded poll helper (mirrors the 'waitForAccentLine' pattern already documented in patterns.md for test/dashboard.test.ts's analogous CPU-load flake).
nextStoryContext: runPlanPhase (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) now accepts an optional `planTargetId?: string` in RunPlanPhaseOptions and returns a NEW terminal kind `{ kind: 'plan-target-invalid', targetId }` (added to the PlanPhaseResult union) instead of the generic `no-plannable-issue` whenever planTargetId is set AND selectIssueFn() returns null; the planner pane is never spawned on this path (verified via zero spawnFn calls). The resolution is a one-line guard helper `resolveNoIssueResult(planTargetId)` called at Step 2 of runPlanPhase, so the function itself barely grew. IMPORTANT: planTargetId is a pure LABEL -- it does NOT itself change how selectIssueFn is invoked. Nothing inside runPlanPhase wires selectIssueFn to a target-aware selector; that wiring is the production caller's job. This means US-003 (sidecar surfacing of plan-target-invalid: notify, event, idle exit, stale plan_issue cleared) and US-004 (meta-loop auto-dispatcher honoring a pending explicit plan_issue) still need to: (a) find/build the production call site in src/commands/sidecar.ts that constructs RunPlanPhaseOptions for runPlanPhaseWithReplan (search for where selectIssueFn is currently wired, likely selectPlannableFromFile with no target awareness yet) and thread a plan_issue value from .claude/cam-loop.local.md into BOTH selectIssueFn (via selectPlanTargetFromFile(cwd, plan_issue, spawn)) and the new planTargetId option so the label and the actual selection stay in sync; (b) in runPostAuditAction (or a new sidecar-level branch), handle the plan-target-invalid kind explicitly: notifyFn a target-naming message (mirrors the existing planner-failed/audit-blocked notifyFn calls), do NOT call escalateFn (this is an operator-input error, not an infra alert -- mirrors the planner-failed precedent's reasoning), exit to phase:idle via the existing exitPhaseAfterPlan no-action fallback (runPostAuditAction's default branch already returns no-action for any kind that is not audit-approved/audit-blocked/plan-escalated/planner-failed, so plan-target-invalid needs a DEDICATED branch only if a distinct notify message or a 'stale plan_issue cleared' side effect is required by US-003's acceptance criteria -- check that story's exact AC wording first). (c) The 'stale plan_issue cleared' requirement in US-003's title implies a plan_issue field currently persists in cam-loop.local.md state across runs; find where it's read/written (likely near writeStateFile / parseStateFile in src/commands/plan.ts or sidecar.ts) and clear it on the plan-target-invalid terminal so a bad target doesn't keep re-triggering the same invalid-target loop. The plan-runner test suite (test/plan-runner-target-invalid.test.ts, test/plan-runner-target-prompt.test.ts, test/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-*.test.ts) are all good mirrors for the new sidecar-level test file US-003 will need.
